test_title: PYST 19: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the correct combination of letters to sequentially replace the blanks and to make the given series logically complete.

X _ B _ B _ _ B B _ B _
solution:
**Given :** X _ B _ B _ _ B B _ B _

**By checking options :**

 
• BBXBXB → X __**B**__ B __**B**__ B __**X**__ __**B**__ B B __**X**__ B __**B**__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• XXBBXB → X **__X__** B **__X__** B **__B__** __B__ B B __X__ B __B__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• BXBXXB → X __B__ B **__X__** B **__B__** **__X__** B B __X__ B __B__ → (It follows the pattern of :XBB - XBB - XBB - XBB)
 
• XBXXBX → X **__X__** B __B__ B __X__ __B__ B B **__B__** B **__X__** → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (3) gives the pattern of " X __B__ B - __X__ B __B__ - __X__ B B - __X__ B __B__"

Hence, "**BXBXXB**" is the correct answer.
